subject: Pilot contract and pricing exception request — Kiosk Health
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@kioskhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@kioskhealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot + preferred pricing for Kiosk Health

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with latency and the model routing options. We'd like to move forward with a 6-month pilot (US-only) to validate clinical note summarization.

High-level ask: 6-month pilot, 2 dedicated slots during business hours, expected 1M tokens/month. Because we're an early-stage payer integration we'd need a partner discount for the pilot — targeting 40% off list.

Attached: Kiosk_KYC_Pack.pdf (org chart, data flow diagram, proof of accreditation). Also shared the proposed SOW from our side in the doc below.

Can you confirm next steps and what approvals you need from your side for pricing & data residency constraints?

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Head of Procurement
Kiosk Health
attachments: Kiosk_KYC_Pack.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@kioskhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot + preferred pricing for Kiosk Health

Anita — thanks for the packet and for the clear ask. Short reply while I pull the right folks in:

- We need deal-desk + legal review for a 40% pilot discount (internal threshold triggers exec signoff).
- Because this is healthcare data, Security will need to confirm US-only processing and any required BAAs.
- If Kiosk can commit to US-only data residency and an upfront invoice for the pilot, we have more flexibility on discounting.

Rishi and Laura — looping you in for next steps. I've attached the SOW Kiosk shared (Kiosk_SOW_v1.docx) and their KYC pack you sent. Please advise what approvals we need and if an exec exception is required.

Next steps I propose:
1) Deal desk to confirm max discount we can provide as an interim offer without exec signoff.
2) Security to acknowledge residency constraints or raise concerns.
3) If exec signoff required, route to VP Sales + CRO with recommended terms and mitigations.

Happy to run a quick sync this afternoon if helpful.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: Kiosk_SOW_v1.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot + preferred pricing for Kiosk Health

Dylan — thanks for flagging. Quick assessment from deal desk ops:

- Our standard pilot discount cap (self-serve / small pilots) is 20-25% without exec approval. Anything >30% requires VP-level signoff (margin & precedent risk).
- Because the vertical is healthcare and there's a KYC pack with multiple subsidiaries, we also need Legal + Security confirmation before we commit.
- If Kiosk signs for US-only processing, prepays the pilot, and accepts a limited-use addendum, we can recommend a one-time pilot discount up to 35% for 6 months to Marissa for approval.

Please get confirmation from Security on cross-border transfers and from Finance on upfront invoice terms. I'll draft an exec approval template (reason for exception, mitigations, financial impact) to include in the packet.

Rishi
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot + preferred pricing for Kiosk Health — exec signoff requested

Marissa — forwarding Kiosk's request. TL;DR: 6-month, US-only pilot, ~1M tokens/mo, asks for 40% pilot discount. Deal desk assesses we can recommend up to 35% with these mitigations: US-only data residency, upfront payment, limited-use license and BAA.

Why I recommend escalation: Kiosk is a health payer-linked startup with rapid expansion plans; winning the pilot could lead to a category expansion opportunity. Risk: >30% discount sets precedent for future commercial terms if we don't guard the renewal.

Attachments: Kiosk_KYC_Pack.pdf, Kiosk_SOW_v1.docx. Rishi is ready with an exec approval template and Laura will handle legal redlines.

Can you advise whether you can sign off on a 35% cap for an initial 6-month pilot conditional on the mitigations above? If not, what alternative percentage should we present to the customer to keep momentum?

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot + preferred pricing for Kiosk Health — exec signoff requested

Team — appreciate the summary. I authorize escalation and will approve an exception up to 35% for a 6-month pilot under the following strict conditions:

1) Security confirmation that all processing is US-only and that there are no sanctioned-region dependencies.
2) Customer signs an upfront invoice covering the pilot term (no monthly pay-as-you-go).
3) Legal to include a limited-use clause and an explicit renewal pricing floor to avoid baseline erosion.
4) Finance must confirm acceptable ARR uplift projection; Rishi please include net present value of a successful roll to enterprise license.

If Security or Legal raise red flags that can't be mitigated, exception is rescindable. Once Security confirms, Laura please prepare the approved-exception packet and redline SOW for signature.

Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot + preferred pricing for Kiosk Health — exec signoff requested

Marissa / team — looked through the KYC pack. Two immediate concerns:

- The KYC shows a Kiosk subsidiary registered in an EU jurisdiction and a third-party analytics vendor with cloud endpoints outside the US. Need Security to confirm whether those interfaces are in-scope for our processing.
- Vendor screening flagged a placeholder beneficial owner with an address in a sanctioned-adjacent territory; I've asked our vendor risk team to run a deeper sanctions screen (will update).

I have prepared redline_SOW_Legal.docx with the limited-use clause, a BAA template, and an explicit renewal pricing floor. I will not request signature until Security confirms the cross-border questions and vendor screening clears.

Attaching the redline for your review. Once Security signs off, I'll push the packet to Procurement for signature with the 35% approved exception.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: redline_SOW_Legal.docx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@kioskhealth.com>, procurement@kioskhealth.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot + preferred pricing for Kiosk Health — next steps

Anita — quick update and next steps:

1) Internal approval: VP Sales has approved an exception up to 35% for a 6-month US-only pilot conditional on Security and Legal sign-off.
2) Legal has prepared redlines and is holding for Security's confirmation on cross-border interfaces.
3) Can you confirm that the analytics vendor endpoints are disabled for the pilot or that they will route through US-only processing? Also please confirm the billing contact and that Kiosk can accept an upfront invoice for the pilot.

If you can confirm the above today, we will push a signature packet with the 35% pilot price and a renewal pricing floor. Would you be available for a 30-minute call Monday morning to finalize SOW redlines and the billing terms?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
